title: Personal Training Packages: the status and timing gate on lapsing a package to expired
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the status and timing basis on which a package may be lapsed to expired.

## Rule
A package may be lapsed only while its own status is active or paused; a package whose status is applied, exhausted, expired, or closed may not be lapsed. A package may be lapsed once the current moment is not before the package's own purchase date plus the tier's own expiration window, counted as full calendar days from the purchase date with no partial-day rounding. Where either the status condition or the timing condition does not hold, the package is not lapsed.

## Points of judgement
- If the package's status is active or paused, and the current moment has already reached the purchase date plus the tier's own expiration window, the package may be lapsed.
- If the package's status is applied, exhausted, expired, or closed, the package may not be lapsed regardless of timing.
- If the current moment has not yet reached the purchase date plus the tier's own expiration window, the package may not be lapsed regardless of its status.
A package that reaches exactly the day the window elapses satisfies the timing condition on that same day, since the comparison is not-before rather than strictly-after.
